_extraction_flags.notes: High-quality IEEE JSAC paper on VLC-ISAC. Comprehensive simulation with OFDM radar for positioning.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig.1: Triple-functionality VLPC system (illumination + positioning + communication). Fig.2: CIR peaks at different bandwidths. Figs.4-14: Extensive simulation results for ranging RMSE, BER, CCMC rates, etc. Table I compares to prior art.
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: Visible Light Positioning and Communication (VLPC). Waveform: DCO-OFDM with OFDM radar principle. Key innovation: Separating LoS and NLoS paths in delay domain for improved positioning and CSI estimation. Bi-static sensing mode.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: Gbps-level rates (up to 1.5 Gbps shown in figures) with 16-QAM at BW up to 983.04 MHz. Positioning: cm-level RMSE with 4096 subcarriers (BW=983.04 MHz). Hybrid Radar-RSS outperforms pure RSS in multipath. SNR range 10-110 dB.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Contribution: First application of OFDM radar to VLP. Sensing-estimated CIR reused for communication CSI. Gap: Simulation only; no experimental validation. Doppler/velocity estimation not directly supported by IM/DD.

bibliographic.title: Integrated Positioning and Communication Relying on Wireless Optical OFDM
bibliographic.authors: Chao Xu, Christos Masouros, Shinya Sugiura, Periklis Petropoulos, Robert G. Maunder, Lie-Liang Yang, Harald Haas, Lajos Hanzo
bibliographic.venue: IEEE Journal on Selected Areas in Communications (JSAC)

application.scenario_description: Indoor visible light system supporting triple functionality: illumination, positioning, and communication.

key_contribution.key_contribution: First application of OFDM radar to VLP, separating LoS/NLoS paths in delay domain. Sensing-estimated CIR reused for improved communication CSI.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Degraded VLP accuracy due to NLoS interference in indoor multipath environments.

identification.scenario_label: VLC Positioning and Communication with OFDM Radar

transmitter.notes: DCO-OFDM with 4096 subcarriers, SCS=240kHz. BW up to 983.04 MHz.

receiver.notes: Single-pixel photodiode with 1 cm² area, 60° FoV.

integration.notes: Same optical signal used for illumination, positioning, and communication.

waveform.notes: DCO-OFDM: First symbol is pilot for OFDM radar sensing, subsequent symbols carry data.

channel_wireless.notes: Room 8×8×3.5m, 16 LEDs on ceiling, PD at 1.2m height. LoS + NLoS via wall/ceiling/floor reflections.

comm_metrics.notes: Gbps rates achievable with 983 MHz BW. BER=1e-5 at SNR~55dB for QPSK.

sensing_metrics.notes: cm-level positioning accuracy with M=4096 (BW=983MHz). Resolution = c/(2*BW) = 0.15m theoretically.

tradeoff.notes: Property 4: Increasing BW reduces total CIR power but increases data rate. Trade-off between positioning precision and BER performance.
